phases.name: repo + secrets + auto-deploy
phases.notes: Private repo created via API. Cloudflare Pages project 'castcut' created (castcut.pages.dev). Secrets + deploy workflow being wired.

phases.name: research + ingestion (copy ClipForge)
phases.notes: ClipForge Stage A pattern studied: request file in jobs/<id>/ + workflow_dispatch + aria2/requests download + release asset storage + status.json. Porting.

phases.name: auth gate (PAT)
phases.notes: Pages Function /api/* validates owner PAT server-side against GitHub /user (login must be motionssalt) on every request. Token lives only in browser localStorage.

phases.name: mode 1: faces pipeline
phases.notes: hysts/anime-face-detector (YOLOv3) + deepghs CCIP embeddings (imgutils) + online centroid clustering. lbpcascade_animeface fallback.

phases.name: mode 1: gallery UI + export
phases.notes: Single-JSON manifest with embedded 112px WebP thumbs. Ordered multi-select, merge groups, ignore. Hard-cut concat + x264 CRF slow compress pass.

phases.name: mode 2: scene pipeline
phases.notes: faster-whisper transcript + ffmpeg scdet scene index + screenshots + agent prompt with embedded strict JSON schema.

phases.name: mode 2: UI + JSON import + export
phases.notes: Paste JSON -> jsonschema validation with numbered errors -> full-quality cut (CRF 14) -> one file.

phases.name: polish, size checks, README
phases.notes: README documents setup, modes, JSON schema, resume protocol, TTL (24h).

next_action: Push full codebase, set repo secrets (sealed box), verify push->deploy, then mark phases done.
